title: d3LLM: Ultra-Fast Diffusion LLM using Pseudo-Trajectory Distillation
tldr_zh: 伪轨迹蒸馏+熵基多块解码，AUP 指标 9/10 任务最优，H100 上 5× 快于 AR、10× 快于 vanilla dLLM
tldr_en: Pseudo-trajectory distillation plus multi-block decoding achieves 5x AR speedup and 10x vanilla dLLM speedup on H100

key_numbers.number: 288.9 TPS on H100 (5.0x vs Qwen-2.5-7B-it), 183.3 TPS on A100 (3.6x)
10.3x speedup over vanilla LLaDA (27.9 TPS on H100)
235.3 TPS on H100 (4.1x vs AR), 8.5x over vanilla Dream
highest AUP on 9 out of 10 benchmark tasks
pseudo-trajectory distillation: +18% TPF; curriculum noise: +12% TPF; curriculum window: +8% TPF
multi-block decoding: +30% TPF; KV-refresh: +35% TPS in long-context; early stop: +5% TPF
65M additional tokens for d3LLM-Dream vs 1B for Fast-dLLM-v2
